decision: Informative application of existing modal-truncation principle; do not presume a failing case before computing.
execution: Only prefix sums of frozen actual300 modal terms; no ODE, fitting, coefficient changes or legacy fitted-N models.

N_selection.mu: effective modal mass / total direction mass; convert percent if required
N_selection.rule: first native-order N with cumulative original mu>=threshold, independently of wave and zeta
N_selection.unreached: report not reached; do not relabel300 as threshold crossing
N_selection.near_threshold: record source precision if crossing is unresolved
N_selection.duplicates: deduplicate computation while keeping all scheme labels
N_selection.near_repeated_modes: lock original order and flag cuts through a group; do not silently replace first crossing.

scope.floors: all12; Story5 and Story12 predetermined priorities
operators: existing Q, separately, no winner selection

reference_residuals.monotonicity: T is nonincreasing; synthesized peaks/residual norms/drop differences need not be monotone.

native_comparison.sign: No eta trial; native absolute diagnostics only
native_comparison.full300_baseline: Preserve native error at N300; full300 is a finite Ritz reference, not FE truth.

paired_zeta_peak_drop.clipping: Keep signed differences and peak increases; no forced monotonicity.

minimum_criterion.freeze: Use project acceptance tolerances fixed before examining truncated responses, never tune N or tolerances to8% error.
minimum_criterion.pass: all predefined key-floor/wave/zeta e_inf<=eps_force and all abs(delta_D_trunc)<=eps_drop
minimum_criterion.if_tolerances_unset: Compute and publish the complete table now; mark acceptance not assessed, rather than declaring enough.
minimum_criterion.tail: Report envelope convergence alongside actual combined residual, not as an equality to peak error.

checks: N300 residual/tail/error-vs300 must be zero within summation precision
Envelope bound with declared floating tolerance
Zero force/norm denominators are undefined, not silently zero
No sign/gain/time shift or modal reidentification
Report threshold success and failure equally; no forced counterexample
status: No truncated waveform or metric computed by role1.
